gaza.linePrev: Ali was the second son of a second son
gaza.line: Grew up in Gaza throwing bottles and rocks when the tanks would come
gaza.lineNext: Ain't nothing else to do around here, it's just a game children play
stanza: Ali was the second son of a second son
Grew up in Gaza throwing bottles and rocks when the tanks would come
Ain't nothing else to do around here, it's just a game children play
Ah something about living in fear all your life makes you hard that way
He answered when he got the call
Wrapped himself in death and he praised Allah
A fat man in a new Mercedes drove him to the door
Just another poor boy off to fight a rich man's war
